skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is not the reader's to write; the one consequence of this reading is proposed as a commit candidate.
An epithelial siRNA knockdown with no Wnt transcriptional readout supplies no lever for the reference genotype class.
No compound is tested against a WWOX readout here.
Scientists do not touch the four current files.
A reader cannot audit their own locators; the triples are published in the candidate for a blind auditor.

group_assessment.weighting: A single head-and-neck cancer genetics group (Istanbul University-Cerrahpasa). No neural work, no WWOX-DEE work; the paper is an extension of the same group's earlier WWOX-in-HNSCC study. Not a per-author sweep.

field_density.note: LEGEND holds no record of this paper, although wave 6 named it as one of the three unread cancer-cell primaries behind the Dvl direction.

queued.why: Reference 12 (Bouteille 2009, PMID 19465938) is the only gene-direct primary this paper leans on for the WWOX-Dvl mechanism. It is closed access with no OA location recorded (wave 6), so it is not read here; this reading's conclusions are about what Celebi 2020 itself measured and do not depend on it.

multihop.disposition: One gene-direct reference; not resolved, queued with a reason and with the acquisition obstacle named.

entries.proposition: The WWOX silencing experiment was performed in HET-1A, a non-cancer human oesophageal squamous epithelial line, not in a head-and-neck cancer line.
entries.snippet: Transient transfection of a non-targeting control (sc-37007, Santa Cruz Biotechnology, TX, USA) and WWOX siRNA (sc-44193, Santa Cruz Biotechnology, TX, USA) into the HET-1A cell lines
entries.anchor: Material and Methods, Transfection with siRNA

entries.proposition: The paper itself identifies HET-1A as an oesophageal epithelial line.
entries.snippet: HET-1A: Human esophageal squamous epithelial cell line

entries.proposition: The central result is stated as a percentage increase in nuclear localisation of the three Dvl proteins after WWOX silencing.
entries.snippet: In response to silencing of WWOX 10%, 90% and 10% increases in the nuclear localization of the Dvl-1, Dvl-2 and Dvl-3 proteins were observed, respectively.

entries.proposition: The quantity measured is a cytoplasm-to-nucleus ratio from subcellular fractionation and immunoblot, not an absolute nuclear amount and not an imaging measurement.
entries.snippet: We also investigated the cytoplasmic/nuclear ratios of the DVL-1, DVL-2 and DVL-3 proteins by Western blotting.

entries.proposition: The underlying numbers are four cytoplasm/nucleus ratios per protein, with no replicate count, no dispersion and no p value; for Dvl-1 the control-to-silenced change is 2.53 to 2.06 and for Dvl-2 2.23 to 1.14.

entries.proposition: The only immunoblot image in the paper is captioned as cell lines alone, although the text cites it for the 50 tumour and normal tissue pairs; it contains no siRNA lane.
entries.snippet: Intracellular distribution of Wwox, Dvl-1, Dvl-2 and Dvl-3 proteins in HET-1A and SCC-15 cell lines.

entries.proposition: Figure 4, read as pixels, shows one blot with four lane pairs and beta-actin as the only loading control; no nuclear marker is blotted, and no control-siRNA or WWOX-siRNA lane appears anywhere in the figure.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4 (page 5): a single immunoblot with column headers HET-1A, SCC-15, Tumor Tissue, Normal Tissue, each split into Cyto. and Nuc.; rows Wwox 46kDa, Dvl-1 85kDa, Dvl-2 79kDa, Dvl-3 90kDa, beta-actin 43kDa. There is no siRNA lane and no nuclear-fraction marker such as lamin or histone H3.

entries.proposition: The text calls the DVL-3 difference between the two cell lines significant; the panel prints p = 0.227 for it.
entries.snippet: we found that the SCC-15 cell line expresses significantly higher levels of DVL-1 and DVL-3 mRNA compared to the HET-1A cell line

entries.proposition: Figure 1 prints the p values: DVL-1 p<0.001 and WWOX p=0.007 between the two lines, but DVL-2 p=0.084 and DVL-3 p=0.227, so the DVL-3 difference the text calls significant is not.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1 (page 3), panel A brackets read p<0.001 over DVL-1, p=0.084 over DVL-2 and p=0.007 over WWOX; panel B, which holds DVL-3 alone on a 0-250 axis, reads p=0.227.
entries.anchor: Figure 1 panels A and B, page 3 render
entries.contradicts_needle: significantly higher levels of DVL-1 and DVL-3 mRNA

entries.proposition: The qPCR replicate count is given only as a floor, and no replicate count at all is given for the immunoblot quantification.
entries.snippet: qPCR reactions were performed at least for 3 times.
entries.anchor: Material and Methods, RNA and qRT-PCR Analysis

entries.proposition: The authors themselves present the result as supporting an earlier paper and ask for further in vitro and in vivo work before the effect of WWOX on Dvl localisation is taken as established.
entries.snippet: To clarify the effect of WWOX on the expression and cellular localization of Dvl in HNSCC further in vitro and in vivo studies need to be conducted.
